Evidence key (applies to all diagrams)
[R] Filing or direct calculation | [S] Management statement/narrative
[I] Interpretation/assumption     | [X] Corpus-contradicted claim
D = dependency; M = structure; C = sequence; O = control
mech = arithmetic/definition; data = unverifiable management figure
claim = assertion; assoc = co-movement; untestable = missing evidence
contra = contradicted; causal = controlled test (none supplied)
[I] Open standards permit broad participation, not proven exclusivity.
